page.layout: One block of running text in a single column. Running head centred above the text, page number at top right. Below the text: signature at left, catchword at right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: qvod literis tuis apud Doctissimum & Ampliss. servatorem Peresium in mei gratiam intercedere voluisti, eandem gratiam ab aliis amicis pariter impetra-bo. Plurimum præterea gaudeo, qvòd clarissimus Petrus à Valle Pentateuchum suum publicæ utilitati non invideat; si concedere vellet, ut Geneseos liber vel saltem nonnulla capita exscriberentur, eaqve ad me mitterentur, de me pluri-mum mereretur. Reverendus Pater Ber-tinus noster Amanuensium sumptibus sa-tisfaciet; descriptio autem fieri oportet, qva ejusmodi lineæ ἐκτύπῳ lineis πρω-τοτύπῳ paginæ paginis æqvo numero responderent, ut si qvod discrimen in de-scribo excidat, facilius deprehenderetur: de Lingva Samaritica intelligenda pa-rum laboro; cùm enim Chaldaica sit, & Pentateuchus Hebræus Characteribus Samaritics [?] descriptus, alterius sit inter-pretatio non admodum difficili negotio: conjicio Dialecti istius etiam minutias qvasqve consequar. Vale, vir Ciarissime [?], & de me bene mereri perge.

page.notes: Running head and page number are clear. "Samaritics" is doubtful (the last letters are blurred), so it is marked [?]; "Ciarissime" is read from a blurred "Ciarissime" and marked [?]. The Greek words are copied with their accents as far as the scan shows them. The Hebrew-letter-looking ligature and the stroke in "lineæ" are not reproduced beyond the letters visible.
